about.title: About
about.tagline: A private skin diary. Free, no ads.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.placeholder: What isn't working, or what would you like SkinSense to do?
feedback.attach: Attach app version and phone model
feedback.noData: Your photos and skin data are never attached.
feedback.sentBody: Thank you. Your feedback holds only what you wrote and the device details you chose.

onboarding.diaryTitle: A skin diary, one photo a night.
onboarding.diaryBody: Guided photos, spot marking, an evening routine checklist — watch your skin's trend by zone, over time.
onboarding.lightBody: Sit facing a window or a white lamp, never with the light behind you. Keep the same distance and angle as last time.
onboarding.privacyBody: The redness index compares each zone with your own skin in the same photo. SkinSense does not replace a dermatologist.

reminder.title: Routine reminder
reminder.notificationBody: Take a photo and tick your routine before bed.
reminder.onDevice: The notification is scheduled on this phone, never through a server.
reminder.deniedBody: Turn them back on in Android settings to get reminded at {{time}}.

shell.deleteConfirmBody: Permanently deletes every photo, spot, reading and routine. This cannot be undone.
shell.deleteErrorKept: Your account has not been deleted.

history.title: Photo history
history.deleteBody: Deletes the photo, spots, readings, note and tags from the night of {{date}}. This cannot be undone.
history.deleteError: Deletion failed. The photo is still here; try again later.
history.noteError: Couldn't save the note. Try again later.
history.tagDuplicate: This photo already has that tag.
history.tagError: Couldn't save the tags. Try again later.
